Summary: Obedience is doing what God asks because we trust the One who asks it. Scripture never treats it as a cold duty: in Deuteronomy it flows from remembering deliverance, in the Psalms from delight in God's law, and in John's Gospel from love for Jesus. Obedience is also where faith becomes visible - Abraham leaving home, Mary saying let it be, Jesus in Gethsemane - and where blessing, discipline, and formation all meet.
KeyPassages: Deuteronomy 6:4-9; 1 Samuel 15:22; Psalm 119:1-8; Luke 1:38; John 14:15; Hebrews 5:8-9
RelatedBooks: Deuteronomy; 1 Samuel; Psalms; Luke; John; Hebrews
